Container.Name: Hikidashi
Container.Overview: A self-hosted, searchable library for your Instagram saves. Import your data export, and Hikidashi downloads each reel and makes the archive searchable by what is said in it, written on it and shown in it, with local models only.[br][br]This is the server: the web UI, the API and import. Install [b]Hikidashi-Server-Worker[/b] too, with the same Data path, or new reels are never fetched. [b]Hikidashi-Worker[/b] (or [b]-Worker-CUDA[/b]) transcribes, reads, tags and finds recipes.[br][br]Keep Data on a pool, such as /mnt/cache/appdata/hikidashi, never /mnt/user: SQLite on a FUSE share can be corrupted.
Container.Requires: Hikidashi-Server-Worker, on the same Data path, to fetch and embed new reels.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database, media and models. A pool, never /mnt/user. The same path on every Hikidashi container.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The web UI and API. Remote workers reach the server here too.

Config.Name: Accounts
Config.Description: none: no sign-in, one library. local: accounts, claimed with the setup link in the log on first start. proxy: a signing-in proxy names the user.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: The address browsers use, as https://reels.example.com, behind a reverse proxy. Empty otherwise.

Config.Name: Proxy header
Config.Description: proxy accounts: the header naming the user.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: proxy accounts: the addresses that header is believed from, as the container sees them.

Config.Name: Proxy creates accounts
Config.Description: proxy accounts: 1 makes an account for a name that has none.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: The Ollama that answers Ask your library, unless the person set a hosted API or an Ollama of their own under AI providers. Empty or unreachable: Ask says there is no model.

Config.Name: Fetch incomplete recipes
Config.Description: on: fetch the rest of an incomplete recipe from the page its caption links to. One request to that site.

Config.Name: Geocoder
Config.Description: A Nominatim to look places up on, or public for OpenStreetMap's. Empty: no lookups, and no map.

Config.Name: Geocoder delay
Config.Description: Seconds between lookups. The public server asks for 1.

Config.Name: Map tiles
Config.Description: Map tiles, as https://tiles.example.com/{z}/{x}/{y}.png. Empty: OpenStreetMap's.

Config.Name: Hosted AI: OpenAI key
Config.Description: Optional. The server's own OpenAI key, for hosted AI (docs/operation.md#hosted-ai). Also settable, encrypted, on Account → AI providers. Nothing is sent until the switch there is turned on.

Config.Name: Hosted AI: Groq key
Config.Description: Optional. The server's own Groq key: free Whisper transcription.

Config.Name: Hosted AI: monthly budget
Config.Description: USD a month for the server's API. Required before it can be turned on; it turns itself off when reached.

Config.Name: Hosted AI: secret key
Config.Description: Encrypts the API keys saved in the database. Empty: a random one in /data/secret.key. The same here and in the server-worker.

Config.Name: Map tiles credit
Config.Description: The credit shown on the map, as HTML.

Config.Name: Metrics
Config.Description: on: Prometheus metrics at /metrics, for a Prometheus or Grafana container to scrape. Off when empty.

Config.Name: Metrics token
Config.Description: A bearer token the scrape must send. Empty: only private addresses may scrape.

Config.Name: Log to syslog
Config.Description: Also send the log to a syslog server, as udp://192.168.1.10:514 (Unraid's own, under Settings, Syslog Server). Empty: off.

Config.Name: Log to Loki
Config.Description: Also push the log to Loki, as http://192.168.1.10:3100. Empty: off.

Config.Name: Loki token
Config.Description: A bearer token for Loki, if it asks for one.
